# Decap CMS

Vendored browser distribution of `decap-cms@3.16.2` from the npm registry.
The files in `decap-3.16.2` are unmodified package distribution files, excluding source maps.
Bundled license notices are retained in the `.LICENSE.txt` files.
Source: https://github.com/decaporg/decap-cms (MIT).

Serving the complete distribution locally keeps its dynamically loaded chunks and WebAssembly files on the same origin as the admin page.
